item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 01:10 AM 15 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(LapuLapuCity), #Guimaras(Jordan, NuevaValencia), #NegrosOriental(Ayungon, Bindoy and Manjuyod) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Dumarao, Cuartero, Mambusao, Dumalag, Dao, Sigma, Ivisan, SapiAn, Jamindan), #Aklan(Libacao, Madalag), #Guimaras(SanLorenzo and Sibunag) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
